findings.claim: ConsumeTrySetHpZeroModifier rejects non-TRY_SET_HP_ZERO (targetType 8) or already-cancelled input. Optional _dontConsumeWhenUndeadable flag checks current Entity.get_isUndeadable before consuming.

With _blockThisHpSet=false node stores current Modifier.finalDelta in action context offset0x58 before Cancel; true stores FP0. This is mechanism-specific policy; no universal claim for all lethal intervention.

OnBeforeTrySetHpZero iterates after cancellation, records first Buff after which cancellation observed into output consumer iff consumer still null. Thus cancellation does not stop this whole native dispatch. Later ordinary Consume nodes individually reject cancelled input.
Post check IsConsumer compares actionContext.e8 with context.currentBuff offset0x10. Templates gate post effects and FinishBuff by this check.

Ordinary no-negativeHP setter branch: after BeforeTry cancellation reads current hp plus modifier preserved delta; min clamp1 when undeadable or BeforeTry cancelled. Writes hp at0x1806fd8d9. Invokes PostTry only afterward and only if entity unfinished and consumer nonnull.
Skadi current skadi_e_muso is event27/82 priority-3000, not old OnTakeDamage预判. Surtr event27/82 priority2000. Makoto exception uses _dontConsumeWhenUndeadable=false.

HpNoLessThanCertainPercentModifier recomputes current host HP and maxHP; if currentHP-pending.value below threshold, reduces pending value to max(currentHP-threshold,0). Attached to huang_t_1[lock] Receiving event10.

DAMAGE_IS_UNDEADABLE_THIS_TIME is 8 in the current metadata field defaults (compressed signed integer encoding). In ordinary DoApplyModifier, flag 8 selects Max(FP1,currentHP+finalDelta), then calls set_hp. Thus the ordinary nonlethal clamp precedes the setter-level zero-attempt hooks and undead floor.
findings.limits: Ordinary HP path, no statement about negative HP, ES, all custom overrides or runtime hotfixes.

findings.claim: On the ordinary no-negative-HP branch, after OnBeforeTrySetHpZero the uncancelled path jumps directly to the final clamp while retaining the precomputed requested HP in rdi. The cancelled path instead reads current Entity.hp, adds the preserved delta and then clamps. Therefore this setter does not universally recompute damage from current HP after every callback; plain healing in such a callback cannot be assumed to rebase the outer write.
findings.limits: Static control-flow conclusion, not a claim about a specific real content combination or chosen Stronghold behavior.
